title: Six-loop renormalization group analysis of the $φ^4 + φ^6$ model
summary: We investigate the $λ\ph^4+g\ph^6$ model using the renormalization group method and the $\ep$ expansion. This model is used in a situation where the coefficients $λ$, $g$ and the coefficient $τ$ of the term $τ\ph^2$ depend on two parameters $T$ and $P$, and there is a point ($T_c,P_c$) at which $τ$ and $λ$ are zero. This point is named the tricritical point. The description of a system depends on a trajectory that leads to the tricritical point on the plane ($T,P$).
